thread:
Olivia - PMM: Quick ask — can we produce a single-sheet 'Field Pocket Brief' that the sales reps can forward to technical buyers? Needs: security summary, short SLA language (separate hosted vs dedicated), a tiny deploy decision flow, two benchmark callouts (latency + embeddings cost), and inbound form routing.
Ravi - Growth: Yes. We also need one tweet + one LinkedIn blurb and a single benchmark image the SDRs can use.
Sam - Solutions Eng: Keep SLA wording conservative. Suggest: 'Dedicated: contractual uptime + model-class latency SLOs. Hosted: operational baselines; contact us for Dedicated SLAs.' Add a small 'sample metrics' box with caveat.
Pri - Field: Triage rules: if request mentions GovCloud, FedRAMP, HIPAA, or 'on-prem' -> route to enterprise-ops; if mentions 'pilot' or 'POC' -> AE; else -> growth nurture. Add checkbox for 'need on-prem'.
Maya - Design: I'll mock a 1-column sheet with 3 tiles: Security, SLA + Benchmarks, Deploy + Routing. Need copy by Thurs AM.
Olivia - PMM: Draft copy (short bullets):
• Header: 'Secure inference, engineered for enterprise: Hosted, Dedicated, Private.'
• Security: SOC2 Type II; customer-managed KMS; VPC peering; audit log export; optional on‑prem air-gap.
• SLA blurb: 'Dedicated: contractual uptime and latency SLOs. Hosted: published operational baselines; Dedicated recommended for strict SLAs.'
Sam - Solutions Eng: Sample metrics for appendix (label: examples, not guarantees):
```
Chat (redwood-7b-v1, 512 tokens): Dedicated p50 ~ 90ms, p95 ~ 340ms (A100).
Embeddings (batch=256, int8 + cache): throughput ~ 25k/hr, est cost ~$0.0008/embedding.
```
Caveat: 'Measured on standard Dedicated hardware; actuals vary by model, length, and region.'
Pri - Field: Quick buyer lines for compliance: 'We support KMS/HSM, audit exports, and on‑prem deployments for air‑gapped or regulated workloads. Enterprise routing for GovCloud/FedRAMP via sales.'
Ravi - Growth: Webinar tie-in: 20-min talk + 10-min Q&A. Title idea: 'Operational inference for regulated teams.' CTA: download one-pager + appendix. Social copy options:
-Tweet: 'New pocket brief: secure inference for enterprise — SLAs, deploy guidance, and benchmarks. Join the quick webinar.'
-LinkedIn: longer blurb + benchmark image + link to landing form.
Maya - Design: CTA form fields suggestion: name, company, email, region, workload (chat/embeddings/other), compliance needs (checkboxes), pilot timeline, need on-prem (checkbox), hidden routing tag.
ops-bot: Draft resource created -> https://redwood.internal/marketing/field-pocket-brief-draft (editable).
Olivia - PMM: Action items:
- Sam: paste final appendix numbers + 2 tiny CLI snippets (tomorrow)
- Maya: first one-pager mock (Thu AM)
- Ravi: draft landing + social blurbs (Thu)
- Pri: confirm routing rules with inbound ops (next week)
Olivia - PMM: Keep it sendable in one email. Field should be able to forward the PDF and get the correct routing. I'll post the copy in the doc when ready and @everyone for review.
